rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING LANDHOLDERS OF SPECIFIC AGRICULTURAL ENTERPRISES OR FARMS SHALL PROVIDE OR ALLOCATE FARMLOTS TO THEIR LANDLESS REGULAR FARMWORKERS
rows.abstract: Requires landowners of a specific agricultural enterprises of farms to provide or allocate a farmlot of not more than one-half (1/2) hectare to each of their farmworkers in which said farmworkers shall cultivate, plant and grow short-term crops, orraise livestock, poultry, or fish, for the duration of their employment. The total area to be allocated as farmlots shall not exceed ten (10%) percent of the land wherein the agricultural enterprise or farm is located. States that the produce shall be belong to the farmworkers but they shall reimburse whatever amount they have adnaced from the owners to make the farmlot productive.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRARIAN REFORM since 1995-08-29

rows.title_full: AN ACT REDEFINING THE APPLICATION OF PREVENTIVE SUSPENSION UNDER EXISTING LAWS ON ELECTIVE OFFICIALS
rows.abstract: Redefines the application of preventive suspension under existing laws on elective officials for any offense committed or imputed to have been committed prior to his election while the complaint is pending investigation or the case is pending investigation or the case is pending trial in court notwithstanding the provisions of Sec. 13, RA 3019 (Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Law, Sec. 24 of RA 6770 (Ombudsman Act of 1989), Sec. 63 of RA 7160 (Local Government Code of 1991). Excludes a MEMBEROF THE LEGISLATURE TO BE SUBJECTED TO PREVENTIVE SUSPENSION FOR ANY COMPLAINT BROUGHT BEFORE THE OMBUDSMAN OR THE SANDIGANBAYAN PRIOR TO HIS ELECTION OR DURING HIS CUARRENT TERM OF OFFICE, WHILE THE SAME IS PENDING INVESTIGATION, OR PENDING TRIAL INCOURT, EXCEPT UPON THE INITIATIVE OF THE LEGISLATIVE BODY TO WHICH HE BELONGS.

rows.abstract: Provides for the basis of composition and selection of participants in the Parliament of Youth Leaders, such as: (1) The incumbent president of the Pederasyon ng mga Sangguniang Kabataan; (2) The representatives from the student sector who shall beelected by the various student councils of all colleges and universities duly accredited by the DECS from among themselves under the supervision of DECS; (3) The representative from the out-of-school youth sector from among the nominees of the various District Coordinators; and (4) All delegates shall be able to read and write, of good moral character, has not been convicted of any crime involving moral turpitude and shall not be more years than 35 of age on the last day the Parliament will be hheld.

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING CERTAIN ADMINISTRATIVE PROVISIONS OF THE TARIFF AND CUSTOMS CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, AS AMENDED, TO STRENGTHEN CUSTOMS ADMINISTRATION
rows.abstract: Declares that the dutiable value of an imported article subject to ad valorem rate of duty shall be based on the cost (fair market value) of the article. Defines clearly the functios of the Bureau of Customs; identifies those persons authorized to effect searches, seizures and arrests, etc. States that "Nothing in this Code shall give authority to any employee, officer or agent of the AFP, national law enforcement agencies or any office other than the Customs Bureau to excercise any function pertaining to the importation of any article ... "
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 1995-09-04
